# Senda

> Senda is a swipe-and-match app where verified adult content creators find each other for collabs, shoots, cross-promos, and partnerships. 18+ only.

Senda is creator-to-creator, not creator-to-fan. Every profile is ID and age verified before it can match or message. Creators filter by niche, platform, location, and the kind of collab they're after — including photographers and videographers.

- [Collab guide](/blog/how-to-find-onlyfans-collaborators): How to find, vet, and safely work with content collaborators.
